method: Revert PR = merged PR whose title starts with revert/reverts/reverted/reverting (optionally after [tags]). Linked to its original via 'Reverts owner/repo#N' or 'revert ... #N/URL' (explicit_ref), 'This reverts commit <sha>' (commit_sha), or a bare #N whose title matches the revert title (title_match). Original must be merged before the revert. Reverts of reverts are skipped. Window = original's merge date. Direct-push reverts without a PR are not found.
